g.text: Where a Scene View Extension runs in one frame
UE 5.6, deferred renderer, in call order. Boxes are hooks you can override; grey dots are engine work.
last Game-thread call: snapshot state here
view family handed to the Render thread
adds RDG passes; nothing runs on the GPU yet
once per view, lit HDR scene color
register callbacks for the stages on the right
output saved for next frame's SSR
if subscribed, runs instead of the tonemapper
runs even when FXAA is off
The Game thread is usually building frame N+1 while the
Render thread works on frame N (Chapter 1).
Render-thread hooks only record passes into the RDG graph.
The GPU runs them later, after GraphBuilder.Execute().
Per-view hooks run once for every view: split screen, stereo
and scene captures call them more than once.
Post-processing callbacks chain in GetPriority() order.
